# Topological_Nonreciprocity

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A topological invariant or edge-state behavior that arises specifically from nonreciprocal couplings, distinct from conventional Hermitian topological effects. Links nonreciprocity to robust edge transport in networks, offering new mechanisms for resilient signal routing in TCC systems.
